title: Shelah's eventual categoricity conjecture
exact_target: Shelah's eventual categoricity conjecture: For every cardinal $\lambda$ there exists a cardinal $\mu(\lambda)$ such that if an AEC K with LS(K)${} \le \lambda$ is categorical in a cardinal above $\mu(\lambda)$ then it is categorical in all cardinals above $\mu(\lambda)$.
